channel.title: Abdulaziz Abubakar Yari
channel.description: Official website of Senator Abdulaziz Abubakar Yari, Marafan Sokoto: Senator for Zamfara West, former two-term Governor of Zamfara State and Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council.

item.title: It’s encouraging to see our youths step forward with such energy, courage and a strong sense of purpose.
item.description:
It’s encouraging to see our youths step forward with such energy, courage and a strong sense of purpose.
The massive turnout in Gusau was a remarkable demonstration of youth participation and support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.
Indeed proud of @ahmadyari01 and every young person who came out. The strength and valour of our young people give us confidence in the future. They are the next generation of leaders, innovators and nation-builders who will take Nigeria forward.
#renewedhope

item.title: The people of Zamfara have always held a special place in the heart of His Excellency, and none more than the people of Gummi.
item.description:
The people of Zamfara have always held a special place in the heart of His Excellency, and none more than the people of Gummi.
Two years ago, tragedy came. The floods rose, and families lost everything.
And just like he comes through for everyone, he came through for them. Quietly, the way he always does.
This is their story. Watch it to the end.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: We visited Four states in one day - Kaduna, Kano, Bauchi and Plateau.
item.description:
We visited Four states in one day - Kaduna, Kano, Bauchi and Plateau.
A full day of engagements and consultations with critical stakeholders, listening, exchanging perspectives and strengthening relationships across communities.
Every conversation matters as we continue building broader support for President Bola Ahmed Tinubu and the Renewed Hope mandate. The consultations continue.
#renewedhope

item.title: I continued engagements in Jos and Bauchi today, meeting with Sheikh Sani Yahaya Jingir in Jos and Khalifa Sheikh Ibrahim, son of the late Sheikh Dahiru Bauchi, in Bauchi.
item.description:
I continued engagements in Jos and Bauchi today, meeting with Sheikh Sani Yahaya Jingir in Jos and Khalifa Sheikh Ibrahim, son of the late Sheikh Dahiru Bauchi, in Bauchi.
Our conversations centred on peace, unity and national progress, as we continue to engage important voices and communities in support of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope mandate.
#renewedhope

item.title: As part of our ongoing consultations with critical stakeholders across the country, I met with the leadership and members of Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa Iqamatus Sunnah (JIBWIS) in Kaduna.
item.description:
As part of our ongoing consultations with critical stakeholders across the country, I met with the leadership and members of Jama’atu Izalatil Bid’ah Wa Iqamatus Sunnah (JIBWIS) in Kaduna.
Our engagement provided an opportunity to exchange perspectives on national unity, peace and progress, as we continue to deepen consultations in support of President Bola Ahmed Tinubu’s Renewed Hope mandate.
#renewedhope

item.title: Post
Still overwhelmed by the show of love, visits and condolences, and I remain deeply touched by the outpouring of care and support.
item.description:
Still overwhelmed by the show of love, visits and condolences, and I remain deeply touched by the outpouring of care and support.
My sincere appreciation to everyone who has taken the time to visit, offer prayers and stand with my family during this period of loss.
May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Ameen.

item.title: Still overwhelmed by the love and support shown to my family and me as we laid my beloved aunt to rest.
item.description:
Still overwhelmed by the love and support shown to my family and me as we laid my beloved aunt to rest.
May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Thank you for standing with us.

item.title: As we laid my beloved aunt to rest, I am deeply grateful to everyone who stood with my family and me during this difficult time.
item.description:
As we laid my beloved aunt to rest, I am deeply grateful to everyone who stood with my family and me during this difficult time.
To the dignitaries, colleagues, friends and well-wishers who visited, called, sent messages and offered their prayers and support, I sincerely appreciate every gesture of kindness.
May Almighty Allah reward you all abundantly. Thank you.

item.title: Post
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.
item.description:
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.
We laid my beloved aunt to rest. May Almighty Allah forgive her shortcomings, grant her Aljannah Firdaus, and give our family the strength to bear this loss.
May her soul rest in eternal peace. Ameen.

item.title: Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.
item.description:
Inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji’un.
I mourn the passing of my dear aunt, Hajiya Rakkiya Jibrin. Her kindness, warmth and the lives she touched will remain with us.
May Almighty Allah forgive her shortcomings, grant her Aljannah Firdaus, and give our family the strength to bear this loss. Amin.

item.title: Today, I also had the honour of paying homage to His Royal Highness, the Shehu of Borno, at his Palace in Maiduguri, as part of our ongoing consultations and engagements towards the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.
item.description:
Today, I also had the honour of paying homage to His Royal Highness, the Shehu of Borno, at his Palace in Maiduguri, as part of our ongoing consultations and engagements towards the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu.
Our conversation reflected a shared commitment to peace, unity and the continued development of our nation. I deeply value the perspective of our traditional institutions as we take Mr President’s message of Renewed Hope to communities across Nigeria.
#ren

The Yari trail continues.
#EverythingYari

item.title: The flood took Hauwa’u Yushe’u’s home, along with over 2,000 others in Gumi.
item.description:
The flood took Hauwa’u Yushe’u’s home, along with over 2,000 others in Gumi.
Then help came, step by step. First mattresses and blankets. Then blocks, cement, and money to pay builders. Then roofing to finish the house.
Today she has a home again. She’ll tell you who did it.
Alheri. The good you do.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: Today, I met with respected Islamic scholars and religious leaders from across Zamfara State, including Chief Imams from our 14 Local Government Areas and members of the Ulamah Consultative Council.
item.description:
Today, I met with respected Islamic scholars and religious leaders from across Zamfara State, including Chief Imams from our 14 Local Government Areas and members of the Ulamah Consultative Council.
Our discussions centred on the important role of religious leaders in promoting peace, unity and moral leadership within our communities.
We also offered prayers for Zamfara State and the continued peace, stability and progress of our nation.
#renewedhope

item.title: Today, I met with the APC State Working Committee and all 14 Local Government Party Chairmen, led by our State Chairman, Hon.
item.description:
Today, I met with the APC State Working Committee and all 14 Local Government Party Chairmen, led by our State Chairman, Hon. Kabiru Moyi Birnin Magaji.
Our discussions centred on strengthening party unity, deepening coordination across the state, and ensuring that our structures remain focused and fully mobilised for the task ahead.
Together, we will continue to build a stronger and more united APC in Zamfara State.
#renewedhope

item.title: We were in Bungudu today.
item.description:
We were in Bungudu today.
Three years ago, the people of Bungudu/Maru handed their mandate to Hon. Abdulmalik Zubairu, our Zannan Bungudu. Today, we came home to celebrate what he has done with it.
Zannan Bungudu has served his people well. He has made the APC proud, and he has made the people who sent him prouder still. May Allah strengthen him for the work ahead.
To my people of Bungudu and Maru, thank you for standing firm with us.

item.title: It is always a special feeling to be home today.
item.description:
It is always a special feeling to be home today.
Upon my arrival, I paid a courtesy visit to the Zamfara Government House, where I was warmly received by His Excellency, the Governor of Zamfara State. @dr.daudalawal I also had the opportunity to engage with members of the NURTW, pay courtesy calls on some of our respected traditional rulers, and interact with citizens across the state.
I remain deeply grateful for the warmth, goodwill and hospitality extended to me throughout the visit.
Zamf

item.title: Hussaini wants to be a nurse, so his people will always have someone to run to when they fall sick.
item.description:
Hussaini wants to be a nurse, so his people will always have someone to run to when they fall sick.
School nearly ended that dream. Then the AA Yari Scholarship stepped in, and now he’s on his way.
He’s one of over 2,000 students across Zamfara being carried this way, most of whom have never met the man behind it.
The day he qualifies, the whole community wins.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: Earlier today, I was at the APC Presidential Campaign Council headquarters to meet with staff, assess the facility and review our operational requirements ahead of the work before us.
item.description:
Earlier today, I was at the APC Presidential Campaign Council headquarters to meet with staff, assess the facility and review our operational requirements ahead of the work before us.
As we begin the task of securing the re-election of His Excellency, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, our assignment is clear: build a strong organisation, put the right systems in place, mobilise our party and supporters across the country, and ensure that every part of the campaign machinery is prepared to deliver.

item.title: Years ago, I welcomed Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu to Zamfara, where he commissioned a township road built by our administration.
item.description:
Years ago, I welcomed Asiwaju Bola Ahmed Tinubu to Zamfara, where he commissioned a township road built by our administration.
Even then, he understood that infrastructure connects communities, drives commerce and fuels growth. Today, as President, that vision continues through projects like the Lagos–Calabar Coastal Highway and Sokoto–Badagry Superhighway.
The scale has changed, but the vision remains: a more connected and prosperous Nigeria.
#renewedhope #throwback

It was a statement about Yari’s political capacity, grassroots strength, and the confidence that the people of his home state place in his ability to deliver.

item.description:
I proudly congratulate my son, @ahmadyari01 , On his appointment as Executive board member, Governing council for the city boy movement

item.title: Like most tertiary institutions, nearly 70% of the work is practical.
item.description:
Like most tertiary institutions, nearly 70% of the work is practical. But without modern equipment, students can only learn it on paper, and it never fully lands.
That was the reality at the College of Education, Bakura, until His Excellency provided a full ICT facility. Now they don’t just write it, they practise it.
Alheri. The good you do for others, quietly.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: 66 years on the farm and Alhaji Umaru Fuloti is still planting.
item.description:
66 years on the farm and Alhaji Umaru Fuloti is still planting. 🌾
In Zamfara, farming has been his life’s work. It fed his family and kept him going. But as fertilizer became harder to afford, every planting season became a struggle.
The fertilizer support from His Excellency, gave him another chance at a stronger harvest. And across Zamfara, many other farmers received that same support.
Alheri. The good you do quietly.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: Meet Bushra.
item.description:
Meet Bushra. 🤍
She lost her father young and had almost given up on school. Then the AA Yari Scholarship of Sen. Abdulaziz Yari came, and the door reopened. Today she’s at FUG Zamfara, chasing her dream.
She’s one of over 2,000 students across Zamfara benefiting, most of whom have never met the man behind it.
Alheri. The good you do quietly.
#yarialheri #yarialherine

item.title: Thousands of people.
item.description:
Thousands of people. Hundreds of vehicles. One bridge. Every single day.
An estimated 2,500 rely on the Bardoki Bridge daily, keeping people, goods, and services moving across the community.
That translates to well over 800,000 people every year. The Bardoki bridge built by Senator Yari reduces travel time, lowers transport costs, improves access to markets, schools and healthcare, and supporting local economic activity.

Every kilometre of road, every bridge and every erosion control intervention has helped connect communities, improve livelihoods and support local economic growth.

item.description:

There, I donated 15 trucks of emergency relief supplies to the thousands of families that have been affected, and set up a committee that will look into the homes that have been damaged.

item.description:

Ameen.

item.title: Barka da Sallah, and Eid Mubarak to you and your loved ones!
item.description:
Barka da Sallah, and Eid Mubarak to you and your loved ones!
As we celebrate Eid al-Fitr, let us carry forward the spirit of Ramadan into every day of the year. May this festive season be a time of joy, peace, and prosperity for you and your loved ones. Let us also remember those who are less fortunate and extend our hands in charity and support, embodying the true essence of Eid.
I pray that the blessings of Allah (SWT) fill your lives with happiness, health, and prosperity!
Ameen!
#EidMuba

item.title: 1,250,000 people.
item.description:
1,250,000 people. 250,000 households. 358 trucks. 147 ward distribution centers.
Today, we flagged-off our Ramadan food distribution initiative at my hometown, Talata Mafara. This initiative, will benefit all the families that need it— regardless of their political affiliation.
As we work to make the lives of our people easier, I pray that Almighty Allah (SWT) will answer all our prayers during this Holy Month! #YariFeeds250K

item.title: As we begin the Holy Month of Ramadan, the #YariFeeds250k initiative is fully underway!
item.description:
As we begin the Holy Month of Ramadan, the #YariFeeds250k initiative is fully underway!
Rice, grains, beans, maize, and sugar are being distributed to 250,000 families across all 147 wards in our state, Zamfara.
May this Ramadan bring you and your loved ones peace and blessings! Ameen!

item.title: From questioning the water treatment plans to asking for specifics on rural sanitation initiatives, yesterday, the Joint Senate and House Committee on Water Resources and Sanitation held its first budget defense hearing for the 2024 appropriations bill with heads of departments and agencies.
item.description:

item.title: Today, I joined my fellow Northern Senators from the Northern Senators Forum to visit families affected by the recent airstrike in Tudun Biri village.
item.description:
Today, I joined my fellow Northern Senators from the Northern Senators Forum to visit families affected by the recent airstrike in Tudun Biri village. Words cannot express the pain and suffering we witnessed firsthand. Seeing orphans, widows, and families torn apart was truly heartbreaking.
On behalf of the 58 Northern Senators, we presented a donation of N58 million to the victims. We hope this small gesture can provide some relief during this difficult time.

item.title: As we continue to collaborate with the Executive branch to foster a Police Force that is vigilant and responsive to the multifaceted security concerns that we face, today, the Senate approved the Nigeria Police Trust Fund budget for the year 2023.
item.description:
As we continue to collaborate with the Executive branch to foster a Police Force that is vigilant and responsive to the multifaceted security concerns that we face, today, the Senate approved the Nigeria Police Trust Fund budget for the year 2023.
With the allocation of these funds, our police officers will be provided with many of the necessary resources to effectively safeguard the nation with greater agility and professionalism.

item.title: This afternoon, I presided over the inaugural meeting of the 10th Senate’s Committee on Water Resources.
item.description:
This afternoon, I presided over the inaugural meeting of the 10th Senate’s Committee on Water Resources. At the meeting, I reiterated the Committee's commitment to working closely with the executive branch to ensure that all Nigerians have access to clean drinking water and adequate sanitation.
We will also collaborate with relevant ministries, departments, and agencies to fully harness the potential of water for energy production, irrigation, and transportation.

item.title: Fiscal reform requires collaboration between the executive and the legislature — especially as we work to improve the coherence, comprehensiveness, and coordination of our taxation system.
item.description:
Fiscal reform requires collaboration between the executive and the legislature — especially as we work to improve the coherence, comprehensiveness, and coordination of our taxation system.
This is why, I am pleased to be in Ikot Ekpene, Akwa Ibom State, alongside my colleagues at the Senate's retreat on fiscal policy and tax reforms.
I am optimistic that the insights garnered from this retreat will help us to make more well-informed decisions that can stimulate our nation's economic growth.

item.title: Access to Forex helps Nigerian businesses to remain competitive by importing their goods and raw materials and exporting their finished products to other markets.
item.description: Access to Forex helps Nigerian businesses to remain competitive by importing their goods and raw materials and exporting their finished products to other markets. This is why, yesterday, at the screening of the CBN Governor, I asked him about his plans to ensure that SMEs and larger businesses have access to Forex to conduct business.

item.title: #TodayInSenatePlenary, we confirmed Dr.
item.description:
#TodayInSenatePlenary, we confirmed Dr. Yemi Cardoso as the new Governor of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
We also confirmed Mrs. Emem Nnana Usoro, Mr. Muhammad Sani Abdullahi Dattijo, Mr. Philip Ikeazor, and Dr. Bala M. Bello as Deputy Governors of the Central Bank of Nigeria.
I wish them all the best in their new roles, and hope that their collective expertise and experience will have a positive impact on Nigeria's financial stability and economic growth.
